pairing: exact within dataset,target_contract,seed; never across datasets
minimum_feasible_comparison_set: all ten seeds for each available fraud dataset and target contract

pilot_decision_rules.integrity: all artifacts and scenario bindings validate
pilot_decision_rules.leakage: zero target-label, row-scope, chronology, role, and seed-pairing violations
pilot_decision_rules.uniform_average: nontrivial directional improvement without numeric threshold preselected from results
pilot_decision_rules.worst_contract: lower maximum contract_regret_vs_feasible_row_oracle on both fraud datasets or GO is denied
pilot_decision_rules.catastrophic_degradation: no preregistered primary metric direction reversal of practical concern on either dataset
pilot_decision_rules.resource_masks: exact zero unavailable mass and explicit all-unavailable abstention
pilot_decision_rules.abstention: finite selective risk at nonzero useful coverage
pilot_decision_rules.seed_stability: direction not driven by one seed
pilot_decision_rules.oracle_features: no deployable input may require target labels
